businessGoal: Allow visitors to browse and find products of interest.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the product overview is displayed with a grid of product cards.
Verify that each product card displays the product image, product name, and product price.
Verify that navigating to a product detail page occurs when a product card is clicked.

clarifications: No details on the behavior of the page when there are no products available.
No information on how errors are handled when navigating to product detail pages.
